## Summary

Brief description of what this PR changes and why.

## Related issue

Closes #(issue number) or Refs #(issue number)

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactor (no functional change)
- [ ] Test coverage improvement

## Testing

How was this tested? Include manual test steps if applicable.

- [ ] Unit tests pass (`npm test`)
- [ ] Typecheck passes (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Lint passes (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Build succeeds (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Manually loaded the built extension and verified the change

## Screenshots

If this changes UI, add before/after screenshots.

## Privacy and security checklist

- [ ] No new external API calls without user opt-in
- [ ] No new data sent outside the user's machine without explicit consent
- [ ] No hardcoded credentials, API keys, or personal data
- [ ] No new permissions added to `manifest.json` (or justified if so)

## Documentation

- [ ] Updated relevant docs (README, CHANGELOG, JSDoc, ROADMAP)
- [ ] Added inline comments explaining non-obvious decisions

## Notes for reviewers

Anything specific you would like reviewers to focus on or be aware of.
